canonical_title: Armadin raises $255.5 million for AI-agent cybersecurity platform
treatment: Repeat only for material product architecture, independent efficacy results, production adoption, major incidents, or another material financing/availability change.
known_facts: Armadin raised $255.5 million in Series B funding at a valuation above $2.5 billion, bringing total funding to $445 million.
The company says its platform uses a swarm of AI agents that behave like hackers to find weaknesses.
Armadin was founded by Kevin Mandia, founder of Mandiant; the round was co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel.
reinclude_only_if: Armadin publishes reproducible or independent security efficacy metrics.
The platform's agent architecture, permissions, containment, or model stack is materially disclosed.
A major production deployment, incident, acquisition, or financing event materially changes interpretation.
notes: Selected in 2026-10-01 LLM Night Lite as a new agentic-cybersecurity commercialization signal.
